meta.name: Mr & Mrs Office
meta.description: Mr & Mrs Office explores the comedic and chaotic worlds of work-life balance, relationships, and corporate dynamics. The plot centers around a couple navigating the daily grind, combining relatable office tropes with domestic humor and romance.

videos.title: Rat Race
videos.overview: As Arivu fights for a career-changing salary hike under a ruthless CEO Chandra Bose who treats family obligations like corporate liability, Aishu walks out of her toxic retail job.

videos.title: Rock Bottom
videos.overview: Buried under mounting debts, sudden medical emergency and unemployment, Arivu and Aishu feel dejected till an unexpected job opening at Arivu's company sparks a rule-breaking plan.

videos.title: Break the Rules
videos.overview: To bypass the strict no-relatives corporate policy, Arivu executes Operation Ice, wiping every digital and physical trace of their marriage, while Aishu dodges her nosy landlady.

videos.title: Tag Team
videos.overview: Bose asks Arivu to test Aishu's ability to fill a vacancy in his team. The duo must decide to drop their secret operation or take the risk of working together in the same team.
